lines.speaker: tube
lines.en: Team, we've got a full day ahead.
lines.ta: டீம், இன்னைக்கு ஃபுல் டே வேலை இருக்கு!
lines.te: టీమ్, ఈరోజు ఫుల్ డే పని ఉంది!
lines.or: ଟିମ୍, ଆଜି ପୂରା ଦିନ କାମ ଅଛି!

lines.speaker: uv_rays
lines.bn: চল, আজ ওর অফিসের দিনটার বারোটা বাজাই!
lines.ta: வாங்கடா, இவ ஆபீஸ் டேவையே காலி பண்ணலாம்!
lines.te: పదండి, ఈమె ఆఫీస్ డేని పాడు చేద్దాం!
lines.ml: വാടാ, ഇവളുടെ ഓഫീസ് ദിവസം നമുക്ക് കുളമാക്കാം!
lines.or: ଚାଲ, ତା ଅଫିସ୍ ଦିନଟାକୁ ବରବାଦ କରିଦେବା!

notes: Video is 17.0 s (prompt planned 20 s); all 8 scripted lines spoken in order, no Whisper hallucinations. Tube speaks lines 1, 3, 7, 8 (pitch varies 217-312 Hz, same character, expressive). UV Rays line 2 is a high 367 Hz cartoon villain voice, deepened -3 st with villain fx. SPF Shield is the clearly low male voice (136 Hz). Purple Tint (244 Hz) and Niacinamide (269 Hz) are close in pitch, so Purple Tint gets +2 st to keep them distinct. Purple Tint and Niacinamide ref ranges are padded slightly into the surrounding silence to reach 1.5 s. Line 2 slot runs into the 1.2 s gap before line 3 (shot change, tube cap flip).
